title: DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017
summary: DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017 is a fast inference-optimized large language model from DeepSeek AI, released on October 17, 2024. It represents an incremental update to the DeepSeek V4 series with emphasis on speed and efficiency, available through HuggingFace, DeepSeek API, and OpenRouter platforms.
problem_solved: Provides developers with a fast, cost-effective LLM option for applications requiring quick response times and low latency.
why_valuable: Achieved massive community engagement (887 HN points, 667 comments), indicating strong demand for efficient open-source LLM alternatives with competitive performance.
